slug: 2024-01-01 São Tomé and Príncipe - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (Data)

facts.fact: The IBA country chapter says STP has recently tackled data sharing and governance in public institutions through the National Framework for Interoperability, which it cites as Law 1/2024 (an act); year taken from the law's number, the chapter itself being dated only 2024.

note: No statement that the law obliges public bodies to share or has been applied, so no duty fact.
